incident_text: A brick building partly collapsed after the earthquake. Bricks are lying across the street.

result.scene_summary: A heavily damaged brick building with collapsed sections and debris piles at its base, suggesting recent structural failure or demolition. Other buildings and vehicles are visible in the background.

observations.description: Significant damage to a multi-story brick building, including exposed wood framing, broken windows, and collapsed sections.
A street corner with traffic lights, street signs, and a traffic signal pole, some of which are partially obscured by debris.
A pile of bricks and debris at the base of the damaged building, with a traffic cone and a green tarp nearby.
Green trees visible in the background behind the buildings.
Several vehicles parked or stopped along the street in the background.
A tall building with a distinctive spire visible in the background.
